questions.stem: Entry fee for an amusement park is \ per adult and \ per child. The cost of each ride is \ per person. A family of 2 adults and 2 children went to the park and spent \ on rides and entrance tickets. If the whole family always went on rides together, how many rides did they go on?
questions.hint: Calculate the total cost of entry tickets first.

steps.explain: First, calculate the total cost of the entrance tickets for \(2\) adults and \(2\) children.
Subtract the entrance cost from the total amount spent to find how much was spent on rides.
Calculate the cost of one ride for the whole family (4 people).
Divide the total money spent on rides by the cost per family ride to find the number of rides.

questions.stem:
The perimeter of the L-shaped figure shown is 56 cm.
Find the value of \(x\).
questions.hint: The perimeter of an L-shape with right angles is the same as the bounding rectangle.
questions.solution:
The perimeter of this L-shape is exactly \(2 \times (\text{width} + \text{height})\).
\(2(12 + 4x) = 56 \implies 24 + 8x = 56 \implies 8x = 32 \implies x = 4\).
